rows.law: hash-chain seal: byte equality against a recomputed root is the capability proof
rows.claim: prove_latest returns a verified O(log n) reconstruction only when the persisted tip agrees with the chain; any tampered leaf flips the recomputed merkle root and verification returns False.
rows.quote: Any tampered leaf -> root mismatch -> False.
rows.steal: The artifact vouches for itself with zero infrastructure: one digest comparison gates the whole estate write path, so tamper-evidence costs O(n) recompute per append, not an auth server.
rows.falsifier: Craft a leaf edit that keeps the recomputed root equal to the committed root while prove() still returns verified=true for a membership that does not exist.

rows.law: atomic pointer writes: a killed write must never leave half a truth
rows.claim: The 2026-09-25 hardening replaced plain TIP.write_text with _write_tip_atomic (tmp + os.replace) in verkle_knot.py and usage_digest.py because a torn tip write froze every chain append via the integrity gate.
rows.quote: # integrity gate; _write_tip_atomic (tmp + os.replace) closes that window.
rows.steal: Durability pattern: expensive artifacts stay immutable, only small pointers get rewritten, and pointer writes go tmp + os.replace under the single-writer lock so a mid-write kill yields either old pointer or new pointer, never a blend.
rows.falsifier: On a filesystem where os.replace is not atomic (old NFS, FAT), kill the writer mid-tip and observe _verify_chain_consistent accept a torn tip.

rows.law: repair is gated by proof, not convenience: fix only the proven-stale metadata
rows.claim: repair_tip_if_consistent recomputes the root; if the last committed row disagrees with it the repair returns ok=false and writes nothing; only when the chain is proven sound does it rewrite the tip pointer under verkle_lock.
rows.quote: Repair only stale tip metadata after proving the chain itself is sound.
rows.steal: Anti-guard-creep in a repair function: the repair touches exactly the thing verification proves stale and refuses everything else; no fallback branch was added to soften the gate.
rows.falsifier: Hand-corrupt the last row's verkle_root, run repair_tip_if_consistent, and observe any write occur (correct behavior: ok=false, repaired=false, error returned).

rows.law: sacred artifacts get repaired only under operator GO, metadata-only, with a receipt
rows.claim: The 09-25 receipt: chain sound (last row root == recomputed merkle root over 9,823 leaves), tip stale two seconds and days behind; repair rewrote only the tip pointer under verkle_lock, ok=true repaired=true, spooky tests moved 4/5 to 5/5, prove_latest verified at index 9822.
rows.quote: rewrites ONLY the tip pointer under `verkle_lock`. Result: `ok=true, repaired=true`,
rows.steal: Separate sound-data from stale-pointer: the minimal intervention rewrites the pointer the chain already proves, never the chain. The receipt also models honest forensics: the stale writer identity was unrecoverable and the receipt says so instead of guessing.
rows.falsifier: Any contrary artifact showing chain rows themselves were rewritten during the repair voids this row; the receipt's own forensics note flags the writer identity as unrecoverable, so a recovered writer log contradicting the torn-write mechanism would also void it.

rows.law: an integrity gate converts one stale scalar into an estate-wide write freeze; silence must be detectable within a day
rows.claim: The stale tip gated every chain append estate-wide (bard weave, ghost folds, usage digests) from 09-22 to 09-25; the chain silently accepted no writes for days and the freeze surfaced only via a test suite, not a monitor.
rows.quote: stale tip made **every chain append estate-wide bounce** (bard weave, ghost folds,
rows.steal: Any refuse-on-mismatch gate needs a cheap daily tripwire (verkle-audit --dry, drift patrol) so a freeze is a red row within a day. Forensic discipline from the receipt: photograph the evidence before repairing it, because the repair destroys the evidence.
rows.falsifier: Reproduce a stale tip while appends still land (would disprove the gate claim), or show appends succeeding in the 09-22 to 09-25 window.
